docs.text: I strongly recommend learning to sail. It wasn't until this year that I started to appreciate the unfathomable treasure that is Lake Ontario.
And then The Chain comes on as I'm staring out at Lake Ontario glittering in the sunlight and can we set sail already, crew? Please?
